summary: Module utilities are named and placed by purpose: generic ones live in ansible-core's lib/ansible/module_utils (root or common), and ones for specific modules live in the same collection, like openstack.cloud or ansible.netcommon.
questions: Where are generic module utilities located?
Where should I put module_utils specific to my collection's modules?

answer_card.title: Where module utilities live
answer_card.answer_md:
- Generic utilities: `lib/ansible/module_utils/` root or `common/` in ansible-core (e.g. `urls.py`).
- Module-family utilities: in the same collection, e.g. `openstack.cloud.plugins.module_utils.openstack.py`, `ansible.netcommon.plugins.module_utils.network.common.config.py`.

Follow the same pattern for your own.
